testCase.name: Manifest Permission Missing
testCase.description: SecurityException due to missing CAMERA permission

error.message: java.lang.SecurityException: Permission denial: starting Intent requires android.permission.CAMERA

agent_response.error: java.lang.SecurityException: Permission denial: starting Intent requires android.permission.CAMERA
agent_response.rootCause: The app requires the CAMERA permission to start an intent but the AndroidManifest.xml does not include this permission. The error occurs at line 5 of the manifest file, indicating that either the permission is missing or improperly declared.
fixGuidelines: 3. Re-run the app to check if the permission is granted.
4. Ensure that any runtime permissions are requested with manifest permissions (API >=23). For example, add a requestPermissions call in MainActivity.
5. Verify that all necessary permissions for other intents are also included in the manifest.
